thread.title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) is Howard Capital Management’s 3rd Largest Position

author: Matthew Jenks
title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) is Howard Capital Management’s 3rd Largest Position
text:
Posted by Matthew Jenks on Jan 18th, 2019 // No Comments
Howard Capital Management cut its stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 0.3% in the 3rd quarter, according to its most recent disclosure with the SEC. The institutional investor owned 159,418 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 542 shares during the period. Apple comprises approximately 4.8% of Howard Capital Management’s portfolio, making the stock its 3rd largest position. Howard Capital Management’s holdings in Apple were worth $35,987,000 as of its most recent filing with the SEC.
A number of other large investors also recently made changes to their positions in the stock. Cibc Bank USA lifted its holdings in shares of Apple by 1.9% during the 2nd quarter. Cibc Bank USA now owns 60,325 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $11,167,000 after buying an additional 1,130 shares during the last quarter. Washington Trust Bank raised its stake in shares of Apple by 0.7% in the 2nd quarter. Washington Trust Bank now owns 86,569 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $16,025,000 after acquiring an additional 629 shares in the last quarter. Norman Fields Gottscho Capital Management LLC raised its stake in shares of Apple by 5.4% in the 2nd quarter. Norman Fields Gottscho Capital Management LLC now owns 39,278 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $7,271,000 after acquiring an additional 2,000 shares in the last quarter. New England Research & Management Inc. raised its stake in shares of Apple by 13.1% in the 2nd quarter. New England Research & Management Inc. now owns 15,138 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $2,802,000 after acquiring an additional 1,750 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Verde Servicos Internacionais S.A. bought a new position in shares of Apple in the 2nd quarter valued at approximately $2,540,000. Institutional investors own 57.04% of the company’s stock. Shares of AAPL stock opened at $155.86 on Friday. The company has a current ratio of 1.12, a quick ratio of 1.09 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87. The firm has a market capitalization of $761.55 billion, a P/E ratio of 13.05, a P/E/G ratio of 1.47 and a beta of 1.23. Apple Inc. has a one year low of $142.00 and a one year high of $233.47.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 EPS for the quarter, beating the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $2.78 by $0.13. The business had revenue of $62.90 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $61.55 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 48.68% and a net margin of 22.41%. Apple’s quarterly revenue was up 19.6% on a year-over-year basis. During the same quarter in the previous year, the firm earned $2.07 EPS. Research analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 12.1 earnings per share for the current fiscal year.
A number of brokerages recently weighed in on AAPL. UBS Group reissued a “buy” rating and issued a $180.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research note on Monday. JPMorgan Chase & Co. reissued a “buy” rating and issued a $228.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research note on Friday, January 11th. HSBC downgraded Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating and cut their price objective for the company from $200.00 to $160.00 in a research note on Wednesday, January 9th. Daiwa Capital Markets set a $200.00 price objective on Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research note on Friday, January 4th. Finally, ValuEngine downgraded Apple from a “hold” rating to a “sell” rating in a research note on Friday, January 4th. Three investment analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-five have issued a hold rating and twenty-two have issued a buy rating to the stock. The stock currently has an average rating of “Hold” and a consensus target price of $195.19.
In related news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction on Monday, November 19th. The stock was sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total value of $647,520.00. Following the sale, the insider now owns 8,940 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $1,698,600. Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
